verdicts.reason: A has a clean headline and a strong CTA, but the price cards are shrunk to tiny thumbnails. Their plan labels and sublines can't be read, and the order is shuffled to 6/80/48, so Yearly is no longer the highlighted middle card. The right-hand column puts the subtitle and the fine print, which is set almost as large, in one cramped block pressed against the right edge, and the logo is very small. B is broken: the headline wraps to an orphaned 'week' that collides with the subtitle, and the Yearly card's '48' and 'per year' overflow below the dark tile onto the light background, where the cream text is almost invisible. B's subtitle and fine print are also jammed into a tiny, unreadable cluster.
